posts.text: Yes, I have, but I’m not bullish on solar PV module and cell manufacturer companies overall. India’s cumulative capacity could reach a point potentially far exceeding domestic demand. Management said in the last con-call that a significant portion of announced capacities in the industry often shows no progress years after the announcement. Add to that the rising costs of key materials like silver paste and aluminum pose a risk. Silver paste alone accounts Significant percentage of the cell price.
